name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, offering unparalleled design flexibility, unique dimensions, and a wide array of materials, finishes, and accessories. They are tailored to fit your kitchen's precise layout, maximizing space and achieving a truly personalized look. This bespoke craftsmanship often comes with a higher cost and longer lead time. Semi-custom cabinets offer a good balance of cost and design options. They are available in standard sizes with some modifications, allowing for a degree of personalization in door styles, finishes, and storage solutions, but are not fully bespoke. Stock cabinets are pre-built in standard sizes with limited options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact specifications for maximum personalization, while semi-custom cabinets offer standard sizes with some modifiable options, balancing cost and design.
